sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Lok Lambert used Darkfog to obscure Rassimov's vision of the Casterwill Compound's gate, in Atlantis, allowing Lok to invoke Lindorm and attack an unsuspecting Rassimov. The spell Hexkill was used by Rassimov to counter Lok's spell, but it was too late. [Coming of Age]

On the Huntik team's way to the Golden Asp, Darkfog was cast by Zhalia Moon to prevent two Organization Suits who were following them from seeing Lok Lambert's Bristlebind spell, making their car bump into the vines and flip multiple times. [The Golden Asp]

At the roof of Dante Vale's house, Lok Lambert used this spell again to obscure Simon Judeau's vision while trying to sneak up on him. However, Simon was still able to grab Lok through the spell. [The Secret of Two Generations]

During the final battle against the Professor, Lok Lambert momentarily blocked Tao's vision with Darkfog, allowing Gar-Ghoul and Ariel to attack it. The spell later dissipated, letting the Legendary Titan sweep off Gar-Ghoul and send a faraway Ignatius back to its amulet. [The Mission]

In the coast of Northern England, Lok Lambert used this spell to cover up the Huntik team's exit into the cliffs from the beach when they were attacked by three Organization Suits. [Knight of the Willblade]

Tantras cast Darkfog at the Erasmus Bridge to allow him and his recruits to escape after the battle for Vigilante's amulet turned the Huntik team's way. [Den vs Harrison]

Darkfog was once again used by Tantras to retreat with his new students after noticing Powerbonded Lindorm in the streets of Venice, Italy. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

Dante Vale cast this spell when fighting Wind hand-to-hand to obscure his vision and help a troubled Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill inside the Phoenix Volcano. However, Wind reacted quickly and knocked down Dante with a spell of his own through Darkfog. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

Darkfog was cast by Harrison Fears to sneakily take out a group of Organization personnel at the entrance of the Tomb of Tutankhamun. [Rassimov's Secret]
